title: Notifications Settings
generalSectionDescription: Applies immediately when toggled — no separate save needed.
dailyDigestDescription: Every evening, you will receive a summary of recent activity in tasks.
popupTitle: Pop up notifications on my computer when Worklenz is open
popupDescription: Pop up notifications can be disabled by your browser. Change your browser settings to allow them.
unreadItemsTitle: Show the number of unread items
unreadItemsDescription: You'll see counts for each notification.
taskDigestSectionDescription: Receive a personalised task summary email on your schedule. Admin and PM sections appear automatically based on your role.
dailyReminderDescription: Sent every day at your chosen time. Includes tasks due today, tomorrow, and overdue.
weeklyStartDescription: Sent every Monday. Covers your full week ahead with tasks due this week and overdue.
weeklyEndDescription: Sent every Friday. A wrap-up of completed tasks, overdue, and a look at next week.
digestPreferencesSaved: Your notification preferences have been saved
